2607.01212.title: FurnitureVLA: Learning Long-Horizon Bimanual Furniture Assembly with Vision-Language-Action Model
2607.01212.paper_summary: Current work on robot furniture assembly mostly focuses on toy-scale settings or single-arm manipulation. We introduce FurnitureVLA, the first systematic study of real-scale bimanual furniture assembly using Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs). We formalize the task, develop a scalable simulation pipeline for expert data generation and evaluation, and build a VR teleoperation system for single-operator bimanual control to collect high-quality real-world demonstrations. To address extreme long-horizon assembly with up to 7 subtasks and 1550 control steps, we propose a progress-enhanced VLA, finetuned on semantically grounded subtasks, that jointly predicts actions and a continuous progress signal, enabling automatic subtask transitions and reducing compounding errors during inference. We further study perception and control design factors that critically affect precision in real-scale assembly. FurnitureVLA improves average simulation success from 48% to 80% compared to baselines across three furniture types, with an additional 21% gain from our design factor study. We validate on a real Kinova Gen3 platform with only 16% drop on the hardest task.
2607.01212.paper_summary_zh: 目前在機器人家具組裝方面的研究主要集中在玩具規模的設置或單臂操作。我們介紹了FurnitureVLA，這是首個針對真實規模雙手家具組裝的系統性研究，使用視覺-語言-行動模型（VLA）。我們對這一任務進行了形式化，開發了一個可擴展的模擬管道，用於專家數據生成和評估，並建立了一個虛擬實境遠程操作系統，以便單操作員進行雙手控制，收集高質量的現實世界演示。為了應對高達7個子任務和1550個控制步驟的極端長期組裝，我們提出了一種進度增強的VLA，該模型在語義基礎的子任務上進行微調，能夠共同預測動作和連續進度信號，實現自動子任務轉換並減少推理過程中的累積錯誤。我們進一步研究了對真實規模組裝精度有重大影響的感知和控制設計因素。與基線相比，FurnitureVLA在三種家具類型中的平均模擬成功率從48%提高到80%，並且我們的設計因素研究帶來了額外的21%的增益。我們在真實的Kinova Gen3平台上進行驗證，最困難任務的掉落率僅為16%。
